findings.evidence: Audio podcast search, playback, and AI song generation operations in MaveAppFunctionService and MaveFunctions are user-initiated via AppFunctions and communicate with first-party Firebase/DataConnect backends.
findings.recommendation: Declare user-initiated audio playback and generation collection under App Functionality in the Google Play Data Safety form.

findings.evidence: User authentication credentials and identifiers (UID, tokens) are managed via FirebaseAuth and CredentialManager upon user-initiated login and registration.
findings.recommendation: Declare user account collection for Account Management and Authentication in the Google Play Data Safety form.
